content.name: Jasmine Huang
content.title: Pharmacist, Community Pharmacy
content.summary: Newly registered pharmacist with general registration from the Pharmacy Board of Australia, after an intern year in a busy suburban community pharmacy. Trained as a pharmacist immuniser and keen on chronic disease care, especially diabetes and asthma counselling for Mandarin-speaking patients.

experience.title: Pharmacy Assistant (part-time)
bullets: Served 60–80 customers per shift, handled script intake and referred clinical questions to the pharmacist.
Restocked and rotated stock using the dispensary system, reducing out-of-date write-offs in the vitamins section by 20%.
Translated for Mandarin-speaking customers during pharmacist consultations on around 10 occasions a week.

experience.title: Intern Pharmacist
bullets: Dispensed up to 220 prescriptions a day under the supervision of a registered preceptor pharmacist.
Administered 600+ influenza and COVID-19 vaccines after completing accredited immunisation training.
Delivered 45 MedsCheck and Diabetes MedsCheck consultations, documenting outcomes for follow-up.
Passed the Pharmacy Board of Australia intern written and oral exams at the first attempt.

experience.title: Pharmacist
bullets: Work as one of two pharmacists on shift, checking and counselling on about 200 scripts a day including PBS and private items.
Run inhaler technique checks for asthma and COPD patients, correcting technique for 7 in 10 patients reviewed.
Manage the dose administration aid service for 85 patients, liaising with GPs on medication changes.

education.details: Honours project on inhaler technique in older adults. ATAR 97.15.

achievements.title: AHPRA general registration
achievements.detail: Registered pharmacist with the Pharmacy Board of Australia since January 2026.

achievements.title: Student leadership
achievements.detail: Treasurer of the Monash Pharmacy Students' Society, managing a $14,000 events budget.
